grades.quote: no storage space should ever be both assigned to a file and marked as free for other use, even if the system crashed just as the space was being allocated.
grades.reason: This is a chapter introduction. It says a block must never be both assigned to a file and marked free, even if a crash hits during allocation. That is the condition the query asks about. It never mentions lost blocks and never explains why the double-booked state is more dangerous, so it gives only limited auxiliary context.
